title: MEESHO Interview Experience + Mondelez International (PPO)
author: SIMRAN KAUR DOAD
body:
1) Meesho (Senior Associate, Program and Operations)

Resume Shortlisting

The process began with resume-based shortlisting, where around 40 students were shortlisted irrespective of CGPA.

Round 1: Technical + Resume-Based Interview (≈30 minutes)

In my case, the interviewer focused extensively on my summer internship at Mondelez International, which was also an on-campus opportunity.

Guesstimate questions to assess logical reasoning and estimation skills were also asked

Round 2: Case Study Round (≈35 minutes)

The second round was a case study interview, where I was given a problem statement related to operations and was asked to conduct a Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

2) Mondelez International (Summer Internship Interview)

The summer internship selection process at Mondelez International began with resume-based shortlisting, where around 20 students were shortlisted.

Round 1: Group Discussion (GD)

The GD round consisted of two groups of 10 students each. After evaluation, 3 students from Group 1 and 2 students from our group were shortlisted for the next round.

Round 2: Technical + HR Interview

The final round was a combined technical and HR interview. The technical questions were entirely resume-driven, focusing on projects and experiences mentioned. The HR section included basic questions about the company, along with general behavioral questions.

Pro Tip:

Know your resume inside out and be ready to explain every point with clarity and real impact

Hope this helps:)
